import json, base64, sys
a = json.load(open('/tmp/after_redis.json'))
b = json.load(open('/tmp/replica_snap.json'))
FOOTER = 10  # 2B rdb version + 8B crc64
n_same = n_diff = 0
diffs = []
for db in a['dbs']:
    da, dbv = a['dbs'][db], b['dbs'].get(db, {})
    for k, ea in da.items():
        eb = dbv.get(k)
        if eb is None: diffs.append((db,k,'missing')); continue
        xa = base64.b64decode(ea['dump']['__b64__'])
        xb = base64.b64decode(eb['dump']['__b64__'])
        if len(xa) != len(xb): diffs.append((db,k,f'len {len(xa)}!={len(xb)}')); n_diff+=1; continue
        if xa[:-FOOTER] == xb[:-FOOTER]: n_same += 1
        else:
            n_diff += 1
            if len(diffs) < 10:
                i = next(i for i in range(len(xa)-FOOTER) if xa[i]!=xb[i])
                diffs.append((db,k,f'payload differs at {i} (type={ea["type"]})'))
print(f"payload-identical (excluding 10B footer): {n_same}/{n_same+n_diff}")
for d in diffs[:10]: print("  ", d)
EOF
